detail.longDescription: RE: https:// infosec.exchange/@ifin/1176305 30054379148 I am firmly of the opinion that for almost all the websites using CDNs, they are basically of no benefit and are used only due to cargo-culting from the olden days when browser cache was not compartmentalized between origins and HTTP/2 did not exist. For years I've been saying CDNs are a net liability for most websites; one of the reasons is that they are a juicy target. Anyone with sufficient access gets to deploy any JS to any site that pulls JS from them. Lo and behold… # WebDev # InfoSec
